text: Dr. Praew is so lovely and gentle! My wisdom tooth, which every other dentist has ever given me, always resulted in facial swelling. But after seeing Dr. Praew, my face didn't swell, the bleeding didn't last long, and the wound wasn't painful at all. This dental clinic is the best! All the staff are also lovely, friendly, and chatty, making patients feel less afraid. Thank you so much, Dr. Praew and all the staff. This is my favorite dental clinic, from someone who is terrified of dentists!
